title: Product Specialist

L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)- As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.- Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.- Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.- Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.- Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.Desired Qualifications & Skills:- Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.- Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.- Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.- Strong communication skills (written & verbal).- Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.- Experience with support ticketing tools (e.G., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).- Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.G., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).- Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).- Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.- Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.- Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and SpanishWorking Conditions:- Location: Brazil- Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).- Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).Why Join Us?- Work at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, and digital risk protection.- Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.- Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.- Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Senior Content Manager
description: As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets. This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams. To be more specific, you will: Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR. The ideal profile We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results. You are someone who: Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must) Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus) Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it You bring strong CM fundamentals: High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills Ownership mindset over site and content performance Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals Experience working with CMS platforms You work well with others and think ahead: Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above. Next steps in the process ✅ 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media Last step: a proposition for us to start working together! What’s in it for you A full time remote work environment. A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours. Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path. Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay! MoveUp Media

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Key Responsibilities: Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. Domain Tracks: You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária. Principais responsabilidades: 1. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva. Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app. 4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas. Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código. O que buscamos Pessoas que: Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção. Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos. Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance. Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean). Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação. Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando\ "overengineering\". Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante. Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios. Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

title: Cloudbees Devops Engineer

Working in a transversal function, you’ll support the rollout and optimisation of CloudBees Release Orchestration (RO) and CI/CD best practices, ensuring smooth adoption and consistent execution across the organisation. Hands on experience with Jenkins, Git, Nexus, SonarQube Experience with SAST/DAST tools Practical development experience in Java/Maven or C++ Exposure to infrastructure automation using Python and Ansible Knowledge of containerisation: Docker, OpenShift/Kubernetes Strong understanding of Agile and DevSecOps principles Excellent English communication skills (client teams are primarily US-based) Ability to follow established engineering patterns and execute with precision Why Join the Remobi Community 100% remote B2B/freelance contracts Access to a global network of top-tier engineering opportunities Curated content, role alerts, and a supportive contractor community Apply today: If you're ready to elevate software delivery excellence at scale and support a global CDRO transformation initiative - we want to hear from you!

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Senior Content Manager
description: As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets. This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams. To be more specific, you will: Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR. The ideal profile We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results. You are someone who: Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must) Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus) Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it You bring strong CM fundamentals: High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills Ownership mindset over site and content performance Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals Experience working with CMS platforms You work well with others and think ahead: Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above. Next steps in the process ✅ 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media Last step: a proposition for us to start working together! What’s in it for you A full time remote work environment. A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours. Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path. Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay! MoveUp Media

Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias. Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar : transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos. Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes). Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração. Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções. O que nós estamos procurando;

Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance. Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade. Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua. Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas. VR/VT Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!) title: Engenheiro De Processos Sênior
description: A Borborema Recursos Estratégicos é uma empresa brasileira que nasceu para transformar possibilidades em realidade. Desde 2021, atuamos na Bahia com foco em pesquisa mineral de terras raras, minerais essenciais para tecnologias modernas e para a transição energética. Nosso objetivo é unir inovação, responsabilidade e eficiência para construir um futuro sustentável. Somos subsidiárias da Brazilian Rare Earths e trabalhamos para posicionar o Brasil como protagonista no setor. MISSÃO DO CARGO: Desenvolver estudos e análises complexas, relacionados às atividades no campo da engenharia de processos, respondendo por identificar e quantificar recursos minerais, desenvolvendo projetos de beneficiamento de minérios e metalurgia de terras raras e elementos estratégicos, por meio da realização de estudos técnicos e análises críticas de processos, para viabilizar a produção sustentável de minérios e compostos metálicos com abrangência em toda a operação da empresa, e garantir implementação de melhorias em processos e novas tecnologias. RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO Suportar as atividades de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de rotas de processo de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia aplicáveis ao processo de produção de elementos de terras raras e minerais estratégicos em escala de bancada, piloto e industrial, visando otimização e inovação. Acompanhar a realização de testes metalúrgicos de beneficiamento mineral ou metalurgia em laboratórios internos, externos e Centros de Pesquisa, garantindo a qualidade dos processos e atendendo às demandas de P&D da empresa. Revisar documentação de projetos de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia nas diversas fases (Scoping Study até Feasibility Study), apoiando na elaboração e revisão de fluxogramas de processo e engenharia, com o objetivo de assegurar a precisão técnica dos estudos. Atuar de forma consultiva juntamente ao corpo técnico, direcionando na elaboração e execução de programas de testes metalúrgicos e na avaliação e consolidação de informações de processos, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional. Elaborar e revisar relatórios e apresentações para suportar as decisões da Gerência de Processos e P&D, comunicando os resultados de forma clara e objetiva para a tomada de decisões estratégicas. Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia, Engenharia de Minas e PMO nos estudos da disciplina de Processos para planta de beneficiamento mineral e hidrometalurgia, fornecendo suporte técnico e contribuindo para a resolução de problemas. Cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas e metas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, promovendo uma cultura organizacional de responsabilidade e prevenção. Participar ativamente na formação e desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, disseminando conhecimentos e melhorando as competências do time em processos de beneficiamento mineral. REQUISITOS DO CARGO Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia de Minas, Engenharia Química, Engenharia Metalúrgica e outras afins. Idioma: Inglês Intermediário/Avançado Disponibilidade para residir em Salvador/BA ou Lauro de Freitas/BA. Disponibilidade para atuar eventualmente em regime de turno. Competências Técnicas: Sólidos conhecimentos em processos metalúrgicos, beneficiamento mineral, elaboração de estudos de viabilidade, gerenciamento de projetos e domínio de softwares de modelagem de processos. COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS Proatividade, orientação para resultados, habilidades de comunicação, trabalho em equipe, capacidade de análise crítica, resolução de problemas complexos, flexibilidade e espírito inovador.

title: Email Marketing Manager
description: ABOUT THE ROLE Our client is looking for a lifecycle marketing manager who can do more than manage a few email flows. We're building toward a leaner, AI-augmented marketing team, and this hire needs to be someone who can grow with that. The role is broader than a typical lifecycle role. Think lifecycle strategy, campaign development, marketing ops, and audience intelligence — with AI as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought.WHAT YOU'LL OWN Design and run lifecycle programs across the full customer journey: onboarding, activation, retention, and winback Own our HubSpot instance as it relates to marketing —workflows, segmentation, product data integration, and reporting Use Clay to build and enrich audience segments for smarter targeting Work closely with the rest of the marketing team on campaign development Monitor and improve email deliverability on an ongoing basis Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate, personalize at scale, and move faster Report on what's working and what isn't — with actual numbersWHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 4+ years in lifecycle, retention, or marketing ops at a B2B SaaS company Deep HubSpot expertise — you should be able to build complex workflows without a tutorial Hands-on experience with Clay or comparable enrichment and automation tooling AI-native: you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically to how Strong instincts on B2B customer journeys, PQLs, and usage-based growth models You can write a decent email — you don't need to be a copywriter, but you shouldn't need one for every send Comfortable owning work independently without a lot of hand-holdingNICE TO HAVE Experience managing or scaling a lifecycle program from early-stage to mature Familiarity with deliverability tools like MX Toolbox, Postmaster Tools, or similarABOUT OUR CLIENT Our client makes it easier for creators to find the music they need. We license high-quality music and sound effects to filmmakers, agencies, and brands — and we're growing the team to match where we're headed. They're remote, operationally lean, and genuinely open to how AI changes the way marketing works. If you want to build something real without a lot of bureaucracy, this is a good fit.

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken) Please upload your CV Resume in English. Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,200 USD Along with our partner, we are seeking a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Manager who will drive revenue growth by optimizing conversion rates, improving user experience, and reducing friction across the customer journey on their Shopify storefront. You will oversee and execute A/B testing, user behavior analyses, funnel audits, and UX gap analyses. You will have the knowledge and experience to use CRO reports, experiment results, and dashboards to identify areas for optimization and will lead projects to implement those findings. You will conduct competitive research and deploy the latest developments in conversion rate optimization in partnership with their development and ecommerce teams. Essential Functions A/B Testing and Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across key pages and touchpoints. Prioritize experiments based on potential impact, traffic, and business goals to build a rigorous, data-driven testing roadmap. On-Site Optimization: Optimize landing pages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, cart, and checkout flows to maximize conversion. Collaborate with their ecommerce and design teams to ensure all pages are aligned with CRO best practices. User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable hypotheses. Shopify & Development Collaboration: Partner closely with their development team to implement CRO changes on the Shopify platform. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently. Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates. Reporting and Analysis: Provide regular reports on CRO performance, experiment results, and KPIs using analytics and CRO tools. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership. Other duties may be assigned What you will bring / Qualifications To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. In-depth knowledge of CRO principles, UX best practices, and e-commerce conversion frameworks. Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design. Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform;
ability to collaborateeffectively with development teams on implementation. Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports. Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership. Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations. Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses. Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics. Education and/or experience Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce. 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team. Core competencies Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and challenges with urgency and energy. Resourcefulness: Securing and deploying resources effectively. Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others. Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities. Strategic Thinking: Identifying opportunities and adapting to trends. Technical Proficiency & Problem Solving: Using tools and data to drive solutions. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Results-driven: Focused on measurable, data-driven outcomes. Benefits A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance. The opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth by optimizing user experience and conversion performance. Two weeks of paid vacation per year. 10 paid days for local holidays. *Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives. Technical Leadership & Mentorship Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers. Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design. Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Architecture Documentation Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation. Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows. Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs. Required Qualifications 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles. Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks. Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products. Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage). Solid programming experience in Python and/or C#, including API and integration design. Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations. Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead. Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments. Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.G., SAFe) and PI Planning. Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid. Key Competencies Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders Leadership and mentorship capabilities Continuous learning and innovation mindset

Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto. O que oferecemos

title: Firewall Engineer

title: Staff Software Engineer Full Stack
description:
E aí, tudo azul por aí? A Turbi é a locadora do futuro: 100% digital, movida a tecnologia, gente boa e paixão por transformar a forma como as pessoas se locomovem. A gente abre carro pelo app (sim, sem chave!) e acredita que inovação de verdade começa com um time engajado e com liberdade pra criar. Estamos procurando uma pessoa para a posição de Staff Software Engineer, alguém que queira acelerar com a gente nessa jornada. O seu papel por aqui: Como Staff Software Engineer Backend, você vai ter um papel chave em repensar a estrutura dos nossos produtos, melhorar a eficiência deles, reduzindo custos e gerando novas oportunidades de negócios. Como um especialista de engenharia na Turbi você irá assumir um papel de liderança técnica no time, apoiando o EM na evolução técnica do time, direcionando a tomada de decisão e apoiando o time em questões técnicas. Além disso, trará a sua visão do mundo, de tecnologias e práticas de mercado que possam otimizar código, projetos, produtos, gerando mais eficiência e melhores métricas para o time, melhorando a experiência do cliente, aumentando receita e tomando decisões estratégicas para impulsionar o sucesso e crescimento de 2026. Mais do que entregar tarefas, a ideia é construir junto com autonomia, responsabilidade e espaço para testar, errar e aprender. O que você vai encarar no dia a dia: Definir o direcionamento técnico do time. Mentorar e direcionar o time na tomada de decisão. Trazer a perspectiva de engenharia para os problemas propostos. Pesquisar e explorar problemas e possíveis soluções. Conectar o time. Eventualmente, escrever códigos complexos. Apoiar o EM a desenvolver tecnicamente o time. Liderar tecnicamente o time. Coordenar projetos Cross. Atuar junto aos PM's e stakeholders. Criar uma arquitetura de soluções de impacto cross. O que esperamos de você: Que você se comunique bem, que seja organizado e que seja um bom líder técnico. Empatia é um pilar importante da nossa cultura, assim como trabalhar bem em equipe. Ser resolutivo, capaz de tomar decisões sejam fáceis ou difíceis em momentos estratégicos e saber delegar tarefas também são requisitos importantes para nós. Assim como ser mão na massa e ter habilidade para influenciar pessoas e conduzir mudanças organizacionais em tecnologia e processos. Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend, com serviços de alta performance (preferencialmente em go e typescript). Conhecimento de desenvolvedor em kubernetes (Criar e deployar aplicações compliant com twelve factor). Conhecimentos sólidos em git para releases atômicas, escaláveis e reversíveis. Vivência em desenvolvimento de sistemas distribuídos. Testes unitários e de integração. Testes de carga. Sólidos conhecimentos em clean Architecture, modularização, SOLID. Seria interessante para nós se também tivesse: Experiência em desenvolvimento frontend. Experiência em evangelizar e implementar práticas de desenvolvimento seguro. Experiência resolvendo problemas em produção, empregando contramedidas conforme necessário, bem como atuando em soluções definitivas de longo prazo. Proficiência em padrões de arquitetura de sistemas e princípios 12 Factor para desenvolvimento de aplicações escaláveis e resilientes. Experiência em fintechs ou no mercado financeiro. title: Full Stack Engineer
description: We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.Js and Node.Js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn. The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software! Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn. Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status. Responsibilities Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.Js and Node.Js Develop and implement highly responsive UI components Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications Monitor and improve end-to-end performance Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems Required Experience Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.Js, Node.Js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software A focus on customer value delivery Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success A collaborative approach, a can do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems A willingness to learn from others and admit when youve made a mistake Desired Experience University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field Additional Information Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays Start: ASAP Core Client Values The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture. Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable. Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team. Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. Theres no excuse for being a jerk. Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners. Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do. Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger. The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses. About Velozient We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Descrição da Empresa A General Mills é uma empresa líder global em alimentos e trabalha para fazer os alimentos que o mundo ama! Nossas marcas globais incluem Cheerios, Annie's, Yoplait, Nature Valley, Häagen-Dazs, Betty Crocker, Pillsbury, Old El Paso, Wanchai Ferry, Yoki, Blue e muitas outras. Com sede em Minneapolis, Minnesota, EUA, a companhia chegou ao Brasil em 1997, quando iniciou as vendas do sorvete premium Häagen-Dazs. Em 2012, adquiriu o Grupo Yoki Alimentos, conquistando um novo modelo de negócios e tornando-se proprietária das marcas Yoki, Kitano e Mais Vita, reconhecidas pelos brasileiros há décadas. Somos hoje um time apaixonado de 35 mil colaboradores em mais de 100 países e em todos os continentes.

title: Gestor De Tráfego Pago

faz anotações com frequência e quer crescer como profissional de performance. Experiência com Amazon Ads não é obrigatória — vamos te ensinar tudo sobre a plataforma. Capacidade de analisar métricas e tomar decisões orientadas por dados. Boa comunicação escrita e verbal. Organização para registrar testes, alterações e resultados. Disponibilidade para atuar como PJ, em regime 100% remoto, em período integral. Diferenciais Experiência com e-commerce, lançamentos ou vendas online. Histórico de atuação em ambientes com metas de resultado (ROAS, CPA, faturamento ou lucro). Qualquer experiência prévia com Amazon Ads será considerada um diferencial, ainda que não seja obrigatória. Como será o processo seletivo Preenchimento do forms – ANTES de finalizar a candidatura no LinkedIn. Análise do forms + triagem de currículo. Aplicação do teste DISC. Entrevista por vídeo com o time. Feedback final (aprovado ou não) após a entrevista. Modelo de trabalho Contratação: PJ – responsabilidade nas entregas e resultados, não nas horas. Local: 100% remoto. Faixa salarial: R$ 2.000,00 a R$ 3.000,00 (PJ) – de acordo com experiência e nível técnico.

title: Back End Developer
description:
About EverUp We’re a UK startup making gift-card shopping rewarding. Our mobile app (React Native) and web (React) run on a serverless AWS backend. We’re hiring a Backend Cloud Engineer to evolve and maintain the APIs, databases, and services that power payments, wallet, rewards, and near-real-time features. The role You’ll work across our event-driven, serverless stack to maintain and evolve production systems. That means adding features, fixing bugs, improving performance and cost, tightening security, and raising reliability—while collaborating closely with Mobile/Web. What you’ll do Maintain and evolve AWS Lambda microservices behind Amazon API Gateway ( & WebSocket) and AWS IoT Core ;
implement authentication/authorization via Cognito User Pools (JWT) and Lambda authorizers for REST/ Maintain and optimize data models and access patterns in DynamoDB and MySQL (RDS);
handle indexes, migrations, and query performance. Maintain asynchronous workflows using SQS/SNS (idempotency, DLQs, retries) and keep observability healthy with CloudWatch metrics/logs and alarms. Maintain and improve our IaC (AWS SAM/CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines, and environment promotions. Integrate and support third-party services used for payments, open banking, notifications, fraud/risk, analytics and support tooling. Troubleshoot production issues, drive RCAs, and implement preventive fixes and runbooks. Uphold security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secret management, input validation, auditability). Tech you’ll touch AWS Lambda, API Gateway (REST/WebSocket), Cognito, DynamoDB, RDS MySQL, SQS/SNS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation/SAM, EC2, ECS, plus fintech/comms integrations (Open Banking/PSP, Gift Cards, Analytics, Messaging, Support, and Risk assessment tools). Must-haves 8+ years building/maintaining production backends;
4+ years with AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB). Proficiency in JavaScript/Node.Js;
strong REST API fundamentals and event-driven patterns. Solid SQL/NoSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning). Experience maintaining IaC (SAM/CloudFormation) and CI/CD (Code Pipeline). Security-first mindset and practical debugging/troubleshooting chops (OWASP). WebSocket/API Gateway connection management and real-time features. Payments/fintech and fraud/risk integrations. Observability practices (dashboards, tracing, log correlation) and SLOs. Elastic Beanstalk familiarity and data pipelines/warehousing exposure. How we work Remote-first within UK time zone, startup-paced, with high ownership. We value clean code, small safe changes, and excellent operability. Hiring process Intro call Technical deep-dive (systems design discussions focused on maintainability and evolution) Practical walkthrough (IaC/API/data-modeling maintenance scenario) Founder/lead chat & references Equal opportunity We’re an equal-opportunity employer and welcome every background and perspective. How to apply Send your CV, GitHub/portfolio, and a brief note describing a production backend you maintained/evolved and the reliability or cost improvements you delivered.

description:

Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional.Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua.Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!Principais atividades:Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, e parceiros.Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos.Planejamento estratégico: Definição e implementação da estratégia de segurança da informação, alinhada ao negócio e às melhores práticas de mercado (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS).Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança.Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura.Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais.Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura.Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral.Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos.Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores.Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória.Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional.Buscamos alguém que apresente:Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afinsCertificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e RiscosConformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR)Conhecimento específicos:Políticas de segurançaSoluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social.Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de AcessosCampanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organizaçãoSoluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurançaAntes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Informações da vaga:Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido)Carga Horária: 220hEscala: Segunda á sextaHorário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Nossa essência Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. title: Ai Project Manager
description: A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados. Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização. Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura. Principais responsabilidades Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros). Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos. Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto. Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros. Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização. Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação. Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas. Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados. Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados. Requisitos Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics. Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares). Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação. Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares). Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva. Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações). Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais). Diferenciais Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer). Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP). Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega. Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas. Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven. Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK). Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares). Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.
