description: As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets. This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams. To be more specific, you will: Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR. The ideal profile We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results. You are someone who: Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must) Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus) Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it You bring strong CM fundamentals: High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills Ownership mindset over site and content performance Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals Experience working with CMS platforms You work well with others and think ahead: Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above. Next steps in the process ✅ 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media Last step: a proposition for us to start working together! What’s in it for you A full time remote work environment. A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours. Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path. Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay! MoveUp Media

title: Database Administrator
description: As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication. Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT. Responsibilities: Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage. Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments. Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database. Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test. Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting. Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency. Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing. Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations. Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies. Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects. Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers. Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities. Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience. A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle. 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments. Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture. Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool. Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment. Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing. Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s) Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable. Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios. A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link.
